scheme_name: Cash Award to the Meritorious Visually Impaired Students Obtaining First Three Ranks at the State Level in the SSLC and HSC Examination
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native or resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Disability percentage must be 100% or above
Must have studied in Tamil or English medium
Must have passed the qualifying SSLC and HSC examinations
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹20,000 for first rank, ₹15,000 for second rank, and ₹10,000 for third rank
